node_types.name: Pipeline
node_types.definition: Streaming write-out path that emits typed broadcast envelopes onto a backing lane with budgeted, prioritized sub-streams; consumers verify each envelope against the envelope-named signing version.

node_types.name: Lock
node_types.definition: Per-tenant mutual-exclusion record materialized as a CAS-acquired entry in control_lane: PREPARE acquires, terminal states release, conflicting acquire is CAS-rejected with a typed reason.

node_types.name: Sequencer
node_types.definition: PHASE-ordered protocol coordinator that issues fence_HLC, awaits drain-ack from named writers, and computes destruction times under healthy-only ack semantics, gating the next phase on lease-quiescent and handoff-resolved preconditions.

node_types.name: Validator
node_types.definition: M-of-N signature checker that consults the parent credential_roster's published roster, fast-rejects on insufficient signers / compromise-revoked / validity-window mismatch, and persists signing operator identities for audit.

node_types.name: Interlock
node_types.definition: Cross-event ordering admission rule that blocks one lifecycle event class on the unfinished state of another (teardown vs. unacked drain-fence; decommission vs. owned handoff records).

node_types.name: Admitter
node_types.definition: Bounded-batching admission stage that emits a bulk-wave CAS proposal carrying budget-coupled and lock-coupled preconditions, backs off with exponential-with-jitter, and publishes wave-start/wave-end markers.

node_types.name: Lane
node_types.definition: Append-only consensus-backed log that lifecycle_gate reads preconditions from and writes typed entries to (control_lane, tip_lane, tombstone_lane); persists the canonical record.

node_types.name: ExternalDep
node_types.definition: Stable handle to a parent-scope dependency (quorum_core, credential_roster, hlc_service, offboarding_orchestrator, compliance_audit_owner, tip_quorum) so this sub-zoom can name its outbound edges without duplicating the parent definition.

nodes.definition: Local handle to parent-scope control_lane: append-only consensus-backed log carrying lifecycle CAS proposals, deferral records, drain-in-progress / rotation-in-progress / pause-in-progress tags, residency-2PC-in-flight lock state, drain-ack-handoff records and resolution state, bulk-wave start/end markers, lease-reissue back-pressure signals, rotation-activation-HLC, and shed/defer cause+HLC entries.
Local handle to parent-scope tip_lane: receives operator-override probationary-fork admission entries with operator attribution; read by tip_quorum for canonical-tip recomputation.

Local handle to parent-scope tombstone_lane: erasure tombstones observed by the audit-key destruction sequencer to originate drain-fence broadcasts; drain-ack-handoff records may also be schema-tagged onto this lane.
Local handle to parent-scope lease_lane: receives PHASE-B audit-key DESTROYED entries at HLC >= t_destroy; also carries drain-ack-handoff records.
Local handle to parent-scope health_lane: receives operator-override classification entries with attribution and bulk-wave correlation markers (offboarding_id, wave_id) for downstream classifiers.
Stable handle to parent's quorum_core: consensus substrate that admits all lifecycle CAS proposals with attached preconditions and re-validates atomically at commit time.

Stable handle to parent's credential_roster: publishes the active signing roster_version, compromise-revoked credential set with retroactive-as-of-HLC, and rotation-activation-HLC; retains V_old as verifiable for at least max(residency-2PC-in-flight-lock max-window, drain-ack-handoff record SLA max-window) past activation.

Stable handle to parent's hlc_service: hybrid-logical clock with healthy / pause-deferred / skew-degraded mode annotations; supplies fence_HLC, drain-ack timestamps, and rotation-activation-HLC. Per-region hlc_service-mode-transition events with HLC stamps published onto control_lane so audit_destruct_sequencer can deterministically detect mode regressions occurring between drain-ack emit and PHASE B CAS commit (r-hlc-mode-events).

Stable handle to parent's offboarding_orchestrator: tracks per-(tenant, named-writer) ack state via durable phase markers; receives signature-only-update annotations on re-emission so completed phase markers do not reset their ack windows.

Stable handle to parent's compliance_audit_owner: typed-schema audit sink for every lifecycle event, override admission, drain-fence broadcast, drain-ack, drain-ack-handoff resolution, decommission-handoff-transfer, audit-key DESTROYED entry, deferral record, bulk-wave marker, lease-reissue back-pressure signal, and rotation-activation-HLC entry.
Stable handle to parent's tip_quorum: consumes operator-override probationary-fork admissions from tip_lane and emits reorg notifications reflecting the override.

Stable handle to parent's lease_issuer: publishes its CAS-budget headroom and dedicated lease-revoke / lease-reissue sub-budget headroom into control_lane; targets of bulk-wave admission preconditions and back-pressure signals. Every published metric (queue-depth and budget-headroom alike) tagged with hlc_service-status at emit time so bulk_admitter refuses to admit on precondition snapshots tagged with degraded mode unless proposal explicitly opts in via credential_validator-validated operator override (r-metric-mode-tag).

Drain-fence broadcast emitter. On observing erasure-tombstone(T) in tombstone_lane, computes fence_HLC f_T from hlc_service and emits drain-fence-broadcast(T, f_T, signing roster_version) onto control_lane addressed to every named writer; envelope-named signing version. Three budgeted sub-streams: (a) new-wave admission stream; (b) re-emission full-envelope sub-stream (dedicated fraction-of-capacity for full re-sign-and-rebroadcast for not-yet-ack-completed tenants); (c) signature-only-update strict-priority lane (no envelope re-transmit; no sharing of full-envelope budget so phase-marker-updates do not starve fresh re-signs) — derived from r-reemit-priority-classes. Compromise-revocation handler: on credential_roster compromise-revocation with retroactive-as-of-HLC f_rev AND attached estimated-affected-broadcast-count, broadcast_pipeline (i) computes an estimated re-emission burst, (ii) raises a re-emission-burst-pending event into control_lane carrying the estimate (r-reemit-burst-event), (iii) iterates deferred PHASE-A entries on control_lane and rebinds each deferred entry's signing-version-at-defer field to the current roster_version at re-emission (no envelope re-transmit needed for never-emitted entries) and emits a typed deferred-entries-rebound-to-version-V audit entry per cohort (r-deferred-entry-rebind / r-deferral-record-signed). Per-tenant signature-only-update path consults drain-ack signing credentials per phase marker: if the drain-ack itself was signed by a credential in the retroactive-revoke set under f_rev, signature-only-update is INSUFFICIENT — broadcast_pipeline escalates to a drain-ack-resign-required state, retains the original phase marker (no window reset, no regression), and emits an explicit drain-ack-resign-request to the named writer through control_lane; named writer re-signs its existing drain-ack under current roster_version; offboarding_orchestrator updates the phase marker's drain-ack signing version atomically (r-drain-ack-resign-required). Re-emission-budget-saturation back-pressure signal (control_lane + paged on-call) carrying elapsed lag and pending-not-yet-ack-completed count, symmetric to lease-reissue back-pressure (r-reemit-backpressure-signal). Lease-reissue back-pressure signal also surfaced (r-s4-5-reissue-backpressure: elapsed reissue lag and count of pending reissues). Shed-and-defer rule: when in-flight residency 2PC PREPAREs (read from residency_lock state) exceed configured watermark, non-critical PHASE A audit-key destruction broadcasts deferred via signed deferral records (cause+HLC+signing-version-at-defer) on control_lane; re-emitted automatically when watermark clears. Audit-mode classification (r-audit-mode-classification): operational drain-fence emissions, deferral-records, wave markers, and back-pressure signals use deferred-audit (audit-pending durable records on control_lane; background flush into compliance_audit_owner; audit-pending count published to control_lane); audit-back-pressure event paged when compliance_audit_owner saturates (r-audit-pending-backpressure).

Bounded-batching admission stage for bulk-offboarding waves. Wave-admission CAS proposal through quorum_core whose precondition payload includes (i) lease_issuer's dedicated lease-revoke sub-budget headroom (NOT total lease_lane capacity — per r-s4-2-bulk-wave-revoke-budget), (ii) every named-writer's bounded ack queue depth, (iii) the per-tenant residency-2PC-in-flight lock set for tenants in the wave; (iv) re-emission-burst-pending event ABSENT (per r-reemit-burst-event — bulk_admitter treats re-emission-burst-pending as a CAS-precondition-failing reason for new wave admission until burst-drained). Each precondition snapshot carries a max-precondition-age field; quorum_core CAS commit re-validates snapshot age against current hlc_service mode-aware bound; if snapshot is older than max-precondition-age * (1 + hlc_skew_factor) under current mode, proposal is CAS-rejected with reason 'precondition-snapshot-stale-under-degraded-hlc' (r-precondition-age-cap). Under hlc_service skew-degraded mode, bulk_admitter shrinks max-tenants-per-wave by a documented factor and lengthens inter-wave spacing; degraded-mode wave envelope is published as a typed envelope on control_lane (r-degraded-wave-envelope). Rejection reasons typed: 'lease-issuer-budget-insufficient', 'writer-queue-full', 'residency-2PC-conflict', 'precondition-snapshot-stale-under-degraded-hlc', 're-emission-burst-pending'. Backs off with exponential-with-jitter; under audit-pending exceeds-horizon, refuses new bulk-wave admissions until audit drains (r-audit-pending-backpressure). Marker emissions (r-wave-marker-classes): bulk-wave-start (admit), bulk-wave-emit-end (broadcast_pipeline finished emitting wave's drain-fence broadcasts), bulk-wave-finalized (audit_destruct_sequencer signals every tenant in wave reached PHASE B DESTROYED or resolved-with-loss-attestation OR finalization deadline elapsed). wave_id correlation key references marker class; degradation-envelope expectation carries marker-class tag so health_lane classifiers compare against the right window. Wave-finalization-overflow event (r-wave-finalization-overflow): if finalization deadline elapses with tenants still un-DESTROYED and un-loss-attested, bulk_admitter emits wave-finalization-overflow onto control_lane + paged on-call carrying wave_id, unfinalized-tenant-count, per-tenant blocking-cause categorization. Bulk-admission is itself an operator-credentialed CAS proposal validated through credential_validator (Tier-C per r-override-tiering) and audited via compliance_audit_owner. Per-tenant HLC-bounded ack windows start from per-tenant ack-broadcast-emit-HLC. Audit-mode (r-audit-mode-classification): bulk-wave admission decisions are inline-audit (Tier-A operational); wave markers and back-pressure events are deferred-audit.

Per-tenant residency-2PC-in-flight lock manager. Lock as CAS-acquired entry in control_lane: PREPARE commit acquires; COMMIT/ABORT/PREPARED-ORPHAN release; competing PREPARE for the same tenant T is CAS-rejected via quorum_core with reason 'residency-2PC-already-in-flight'. Lock HLC-bounded to prepared-window. PREPARED-ORPHAN is terminal per (tenant_key, V+1); fresh attempt_id cannot escape; recovery requires Tier-A operator M-of-N elevated (validated through credential_validator) AND tenant_store clean-rollback-complete signal. FIFO admission per-tenant-T queue depth published into control_lane (r-lock-fifo-admission); operator-elevated abort directives carry an explicit next-attempt-version-hint and the next acquire on (T, V+next) admits only after the abort's release+drain-grace HLC has elapsed AND any queued bulk_admitter wave touching tenants in the cohort has been given one admission attempt at the cleared lock state. Lock-acquire-starvation signal (r-lock-starvation-signal) on control_lane + paged on-call when a tenant's bulk_admitter retry-count under override-driven thrash exceeds threshold; signal carries tenant_key, retry-count, current lock holder version, elapsed wait. Per-region in-flight-PREPARE-set published into control_lane so teardown_interlock can read it as a node-decommission precondition (r-decommission-lock-precondition). Publishes the residency-2PC-in-flight lock set into control_lane as a precondition source for bulk_admitter and audit_destruct_sequencer. Audit-mode (r-audit-mode-classification): lock acquire/release are deferred-audit; PREPARED-ORPHAN-recovery elevation is inline-audit (Tier-A).

PHASE A / PHASE B audit-key destruction sequencer. PHASE A: on observing erasure-tombstone(T) in tombstone_lane, drives broadcast_pipeline to emit drain-fence(T, f_T) and tracks per-(T, named-writer) ack state via offboarding_orchestrator phase markers. PHASE B: emits an audit-key destruction CAS proposal whose preconditions include: (i) lease-quiescent(T) — no active or prepared lease for T, no in-flight handoff-fence for T; (ii) every drain-ack-handoff record for T resolved or no-residual-writes-expected, or a credential_validator-validated resolved-with-loss-attestation has landed (r-loss-attestation-phaseb); (iii) hlc_service current mode AND per-region mode envelope spanning f_T forward (r-phase-b-health-recheck — if any region contributing a drain-ack to observed_ack_hlc has had a mode regression between drain-ack emit and PHASE B CAS commit, proposal is CAS-rejected 'health-mode-regressed-mid-window' and t_destroy is recomputed via worst-case path with a fresh healthy-mode drain-ack required from the regressed region); (iv) no-retroactively-revoked-drain-ack-signers (r-phase-b-no-revoked-acks — refuses commit if any contributing drain-ack signed by a credential in the active retroactive-revoke set; drain-ack-resign-required state PHASE-B-blocking only for affected tenants, not whole wave). t_destroy = max(observed_ack_hlc, f_T + skew_bound) + write-delivery-grace; observed_ack_hlc used ONLY when every contributing drain-ack carries hlc_service-status=healthy continuously through PHASE B CAS commit; otherwise computed from worst-case drain-ack-pause-deferred completion HLC + skew_bound + write-delivery-grace; PHASE B does not commit until any pause-window has ended and a healthy-mode drain-ack has landed. CAS-commits the audit-key DESTROYED entry to lease_lane at HLC >= t_destroy. PHASE B does not commit while any drain-ack outstanding (including drain-ack-handoff records still in pending-flush) unless explicitly resolved-with-loss-attestation under credential_validator-validated Tier-B operator M-of-N. Signals bulk_admitter when every tenant in a wave has reached PHASE B DESTROYED or resolved-with-loss-attestation (input to bulk-wave-finalized marker per r-wave-marker-classes). Audit-mode (r-audit-mode-classification): PHASE A deferral records are deferred-audit; PHASE B DESTROYED CAS commit is inline-audit (Tier-A) — co-committed atomically with the compliance_audit_owner audit entry.

Operator-override admission validator. Every operator-override CAS proposal (probationary-fork admission, single-region cross-witness override classification, residency-2PC abort directive, PREPARED-ORPHAN-recovery, decommission-handoff-loss-attestation, bulk-offboarding admission, drain-ack-resign-required Tier-A elevation) carries M-of-N signatures drawn from a NAMED roster_version. Validator consults credential_roster's published roster in control_lane: rejects fast on insufficient signers, signers in compromise-revoked set (under broadcast's named version, with retroactive-as-of-HLC honored), or validity-window mismatch. Commit-time CAS precondition includes the FULL retroactive-as-of-HLC list for every signer in the partial M-of-N collection (r-validator-retroactive-recheck): if any signer's compromise-revoked-as-of-HLC <= that signature's collection-HLC, override is CAS-rejected 'signer-retroactively-revoked'. On signer-retroactively-revoked rejection, emits override-stalled event (control_lane + paged on-call) carrying override_id, missing-signer-count, retroactive-revoke-cause; partial-collection abandonment is typed audit event with full attribution; no silent drop (r-validator-stall-event). Persists signing operator identities into the admitted record on control_lane and binds every admitted record to an explicit signing roster_version field so the rotation-activation-HLC boundary applies (records signed strictly before activation HLC verify under V_old, after under V_new). Every operator-override abort directive's intent-to-re-aim attribution is recorded into the lock-state entry on control_lane so residency_lock admission ordering can deterministically prioritize fresh PREPAREs vs bulk-wave admissions and audit can attribute starvation events (r-lock-override-attribution). Override priority tiering (r-override-tiering): Tier-A (PREPARED-ORPHAN recovery, drain-ack loss-attestation, drain-ack-resign-required elevation), Tier-B (residency-2PC abort, decommission-handoff-loss), Tier-C (bulk-offboarding admission, probationary-fork). Per-tier credential_validator throughput budget on control_lane; higher-tier admitted first; lower-tier may be CAS-rejected 'override-tier-deferred-by-higher-tier-incident' with documented retry policy; tier classification is typed audit entry. Override-channel-saturation back-pressure signal (control_lane + paged) carrying per-tier pending counts and elapsed-collection-lag (r-override-channel-saturation); credential_roster publishes operator-pool throughput as a separate signal so validator attributes saturation cause. Partial M-of-N collections persisted as durable collection-checkpoint records on control_lane (signed by replica, with collection_id + per-signer signature + collection_HLC + override-class) (r-collection-checkpoint); on re-entry, recovering replica re-reads collection-checkpoints and resumes from last checkpoint; partial collections older than configurable grace window without progress typed-audited 'collection-abandoned-on-recovery' and operator paged. Audit-mode (r-audit-mode-classification): override admissions and tier classifications are inline-audit (Tier-A operational); collection-checkpoint writes and back-pressure events are deferred-audit.

Teardown-overlap interlock. Admission rule on node-teardown lifecycle events: rejects admission while ANY in-flight per-tenant drain-fence on the target node is still unacked. Decommission admission CAS precondition ALSO includes an in-flight-residency-2PC-PREPARE-set on this node read from residency_lock state in control_lane (r-decommission-lock-precondition); decommission CAS-rejected 'residency-2pc-in-flight-on-node' if any PREPARE active. If decommission must proceed despite in-flight PREPAREs (operator-elevated through credential_validator Tier-B), admission carries an abort-and-handoff directive that atomically aborts all in-flight PREPAREs on the decommissioning region (transitioning each to PREPARED-ORPHAN with full audit attribution) AND signals credential_validator to admit any pending (tenant_key, V+next) recovery PREPAREs on a successor region under elevated M-of-N (r-elevated-decommission-abort). Drain-ack-handoff escape: nodes that cannot flush within their teardown window write a durable drain-ack-handoff record on lease_lane (or schema-tagged on tombstone_lane) naming a successor instance or persistent buffer; ack-by-handoff treated as ack only after handoff record resolves to handoff-flushed terminal state OR is resolved-with-loss-attestation under credential_validator-validated Tier-B operator M-of-N. Decommission-handoff-transfer recursion: decommissioning a successor buffer is itself a lifecycle event admitted by this interlock requiring every pending-flush handoff record the buffer owns to be resolved or transferred-to-another-successor; transfer recursively re-applies the SLA contract. Maintains an explicit handoff-ownership-graph in control_lane; every transfer-of-handoff CAS proposal includes a no-cycle-precondition (target is not already an ancestor of source in ownership graph) and target-healthy-precondition (target is not in admitted decommission state); rejection reasons 'handoff-cycle-detected' and 'transfer-target-decommissioning' typed-audited (r-handoff-ownership-graph). When no healthy transfer-target exists, raises a handoff-orphan-imminent event (control_lane + paged on-call) AND blocks the source's decommission until either a fresh transfer-target appears OR Tier-B operator-elevated M-of-N (validated through credential_validator) approves resolved-with-loss-attestation (r-handoff-orphan-event). A buffer cannot be decommissioned while any unresolved handoff is still owned by it. Audit-mode (r-audit-mode-classification): every interlock decision is typed-audited via compliance_audit_owner — admission decisions are inline-audit (Tier-A operational); handoff-ownership-graph mutations and orphan-imminent events are deferred-audit.

requirements.description: lifecycle_gate maintains a per-tenant residency-2PC-in-flight lock in control_lane: PREPARE commit acquires; COMMIT/ABORT/PREPARED-ORPHAN release; competing PREPARE for same tenant T is CAS-rejected with reason 'residency-2PC-already-in-flight'. The lock is HLC-bounded (matches prepared-window). PREPARED-ORPHAN is a terminal state per (tenant_key, V+1) tuple — fresh attempt_id cannot escape PREPARED-ORPHAN; recovery requires operator M-of-N elevated AND tenant_store clean-rollback-complete.

lifecycle_gate's bulk-offboarding wave admission CAS proposal includes lease_issuer's CAS budget headroom and every named-writer's bounded queue depth as preconditions; admission is rejected with 'lease-issuer-budget-insufficient' or 'writer-queue-full' when the precondition fails; bulk-admission backs off with exponential-with-jitter. lease_issuer publishes its current CAS budget headroom to control_lane.

Decommissioning a successor buffer is a lifecycle event admitted by lifecycle_gate that requires all pending-flush handoff records the buffer owns to be either resolved or transferred-to-another-successor (recursive handoff re-applying the same SLA contract); a buffer cannot be decommissioned while any unresolved handoff is still owned by it.

lifecycle_gate's PHASE B t_destroy computation uses observed_ack_hlc only when every contributing drain-ack was emitted under healthy hlc_service; otherwise t_destroy is computed from the worst-case drain-ack-pause-deferred completion HLC + skew_bound + write-delivery-grace. PHASE B does not commit until any pause-window has ended and a healthy-mode drain-ack has landed for affected writers.

Re-sign-and-rebroadcast does not reset per-tenant ack windows for tenants whose broadcast had already reached an ack-completed phase (FLUSH-COMPLETE, ACK-EMITTED, ATTESTATION-WRITTEN, TERMINAL); re-emission carries a per-tenant signature-only-update annotation updating the broadcast's signing roster_version in offboarding_orchestrator's phase marker without resetting the window. Only tenants not yet ack-completed receive a fresh ack window.

Re-emission has its own dedicated bandwidth budget within lifecycle_gate's broadcast pipeline, separate from new-wave admission, sized as a fraction of total broadcast pipeline capacity to bound impact on new-wave admission.

lifecycle_gate may issue an operator-override classification (under M-of-N from credential_roster's published roster) that promotes a single-region classification past the cross-witness window with operator attribution recorded into health_lane and audited via compliance_audit_owner.

lifecycle_gate originates drain-fence broadcasts on observing erasure-tombstone for tenant T; broadcast carries fence-HLC f_T and signing roster_version; every named writer flushes in-flight audit writes for T to compliance_audit then acks drain to tenant_store within the HLC-bounded ack window; offboarding_orchestrator tracks per-(T, writer) ack state via durable phase markers.

lifecycle_gate-signed broadcasts (drain-fence in particular) carry the signing roster_version as part of the broadcast itself; consumers verify signatures against the broadcast's NAMED roster_version, not a cached version. Signed broadcasts remain verifiable for the duration of their HLC-bounded ack window even after a scheduled roster rotation activates a strictly newer version.

lifecycle_gate admits bulk-offboarding waves with documented max-tenants-per-wave and inter-wave spacing; per-writer bounded ack queues with explicit back-pressure stall further wave admission rather than dropping broadcasts or expiring HLC windows; per-tenant HLC-bounded ack windows start from per-tenant ack-broadcast-emit-HLC, not from the bulk operator action HLC.

lifecycle_gate's teardown-overlap interlock: node-teardown is not admitted while any in-flight per-tenant drain-fence on that node is unacked. Nodes that cannot flush within their teardown window write a durable drain-ack-handoff record naming a successor instance or persistent buffer; ack-by-handoff is treated as ack for the certificate of deletion. No silent drop and no unbounded wait.

lifecycle_gate broadcast pipeline MUST shed-and-defer non-critical PHASE A audit-key destruction entries when in-flight residency 2PC PREPAREs exceed a configured watermark; deferred entries are written as explicit deferral records in control_lane with cause and HLC, and re-emitted when the watermark clears, with no silent stall.

lifecycle_gate bulk-wave admission MUST budget bulk-offboarding throughput against lease-revoke-priority sub-stream capacity (not total lease_lane capacity); back-pressure on bulk-wave is signaled when the revoke sub-stream nears its budget independent of lease-prepared occupancy.

lifecycle_gate MUST surface an explicit back-pressure signal (recorded in control_lane and paged on-call) when the lease-reissue sub-stream budget saturates beyond a configurable horizon following a compromise-revocation broadcast; the signal carries the elapsed reissue lag and the count of pending reissues.

lifecycle_gate MUST publish bulk-wave start and end markers on control_lane carrying (offboarding_id, wave_id, expected-region-set, expected-degradation-envelope); health_lane consumers MUST correlate classification entries with these markers via wave_id.

lifecycle_gate's rotation-activate MUST record an activation HLC; records signed strictly before the activation HLC verify under V_old and records signed strictly after verify under V_new. credential_roster MUST retain V_old as verifiable for at least max(residency-2PC-in-flight-lock max-window, handoff-record SLA max-window) past activation.

broadcast_pipeline's re-emission sub-stream splits into a strict-priority signature-only-update lane (no envelope re-transmit) and a budgeted full-envelope re-sign-and-rebroadcast lane for not-yet-ack-completed tenants; the signature-only-update lane MUST NOT consume the full-envelope budget so ack-completed phase marker updates do not starve fresh re-signs.

On compromise-revocation events from credential_roster, broadcast_pipeline computes an estimated re-emission burst from the revocation's named retroactive-as-of-HLC AND the credential_roster-attached estimated-affected-broadcast-count; raises a re-emission-burst-pending event into control_lane carrying the estimate; bulk_admitter MUST treat the re-emission-burst-pending event as a CAS-precondition-failing reason for new wave admission until burst-drained.

broadcast_pipeline surfaces a re-emission-budget-saturation back-pressure signal (lane_control + paged on-call), carrying elapsed lag and pending-not-yet-ack-completed count, symmetric to the lease-reissue back-pressure signal.

residency_lock acquires are admitted FIFO via a per-tenant-T queue depth published into control_lane; operator-elevated abort directive carries an explicit next-attempt-version-hint; next acquire on (T, V+next) is admitted only after the abort's release+drain-grace HLC has elapsed AND any queued bulk_admitter wave touching tenants in the cohort has been given one admission attempt at the cleared lock state.

credential_validator records every operator-override abort directive's intent-to-re-aim attribution into the lock-state entry on lane_control so residency_lock admission ordering can deterministically prioritize fresh PREPAREs vs bulk-wave admissions and audit can attribute starvation events.

residency_lock surfaces a lock-acquire-starvation signal (lane_control + paged on-call) when a tenant's bulk_admitter retry-count exceeds a configurable threshold under override-driven thrash; signal carries tenant_key, retry-count, current lock holder version, and elapsed wait.

audit_destruct_sequencer's PHASE B CAS precondition MUST include hlc_service current mode and the per-region mode envelope spanning f_T forward; commit re-validates atomically. If any region contributing a drain-ack to observed_ack_hlc has had a mode regression between its drain-ack emit and PHASE B CAS commit, the proposal is CAS-rejected with reason 'health-mode-regressed-mid-window' and t_destroy is recomputed via the worst-case path with a fresh healthy-mode drain-ack required from the regressed region.

ext_hlc_service handle publishes per-region hlc_service-mode-transition events with HLC stamps onto lane_control so audit_destruct_sequencer can deterministically detect mode regressions occurring between drain-ack emit and PHASE B CAS commit.

credential_validator's commit-time CAS precondition MUST include the full retroactive-as-of-HLC list for every signer in the partial M-of-N collection (not just compromise-revoked-at-collection-time). If any signer's compromise-revoked-as-of-HLC is <= that signature's collection-HLC, the override is CAS-rejected with reason 'signer-retroactively-revoked'.

On signer-retroactively-revoked CAS-rejection, credential_validator emits an explicit override-stalled event onto lane_control + paged on-call carrying override_id, missing-signer-count, and retroactive-revoke-cause; partial-collection abandonment is a typed audit event via compliance_audit_owner with full attribution. No silent drop.

teardown_interlock maintains an explicit handoff-ownership-graph in control_lane; every transfer-of-handoff CAS proposal includes a no-cycle-precondition (target is not already an ancestor of source in the ownership graph) and a target-healthy-precondition (target is not in admitted decommission state). Rejection reasons 'handoff-cycle-detected' and 'transfer-target-decommissioning' are typed-audited.

When no healthy transfer-target exists for a pending-flush handoff record on a buffer admitted for decommission, teardown_interlock raises a handoff-orphan-imminent event onto control_lane + paged on-call AND blocks the source's decommission until either a fresh transfer-target appears OR an operator-elevated M-of-N (validated through credential_validator) approves resolved-with-loss-attestation.

audit_destruct_sequencer's PHASE B precondition treats resolved-with-loss-attestation as a satisfying terminal state ONLY after the credential_validator-validated operator M-of-N attestation has landed on control_lane with full attribution; otherwise PHASE B continues to wait.

bulk_admitter wave-admission CAS proposal precondition MUST attach a max-precondition-age field; quorum_core CAS commit re-validates snapshot age against current hlc_service mode-aware bound; if snapshot is older than max-precondition-age * (1 + hlc_skew_factor) under current mode, proposal is CAS-rejected with reason 'precondition-snapshot-stale-under-degraded-hlc'.

Under hlc_service skew-degraded mode, bulk_admitter MUST shrink max-tenants-per-wave by a documented factor and lengthen inter-wave spacing; the degraded-mode wave envelope is published as a typed envelope on control_lane and audited via compliance_audit_owner.

Every queue-depth and budget-headroom metric published into control_lane (by lease_issuer or named-writer queue-depth publishers) MUST be tagged with hlc_service-status at emit time so bulk_admitter can refuse to admit on precondition snapshots tagged with degraded mode unless the proposal explicitly opts in (credential_validator-validated operator override).

broadcast_pipeline's per-tenant signature-only-update path MUST consult drain-ack signing credentials per phase marker; for markers whose drain-ack was signed by a credential in the retroactive-revoke set under f_rev, signature-only-update is insufficient — broadcast_pipeline escalates to a drain-ack-resign-required state, retains the original phase marker (no window reset, no regression), and emits a drain-ack-resign-request to the named writer through control_lane; named writer re-signs its existing drain-ack under current roster_version; offboarding_orchestrator updates the phase marker's drain-ack signing version atomically.

audit_destruct_sequencer's PHASE B precondition for tenant T includes a no-retroactively-revoked-drain-ack-signers check; PHASE B refuses to commit if any contributing drain-ack is signed by a credential in the active retroactive-revoke set; the drain-ack-resign-required state is PHASE-B-blocking only for the affected tenants, not the whole wave.

credential_validator classifies overrides into priority tiers (Tier-A: PREPARED-ORPHAN recovery, drain-ack loss-attestation; Tier-B: residency-2PC abort, decommission-handoff-loss; Tier-C: bulk-offboarding admission, probationary-fork) with documented per-tier credential_validator throughput budget on control_lane; higher-tier overrides admitted first; lower-tier overrides may be CAS-rejected with reason 'override-tier-deferred-by-higher-tier-incident' and a documented retry policy. Tier classification is recorded as a typed audit entry via compliance_audit_owner.

credential_validator surfaces an override-channel-saturation back-pressure signal (control_lane + paged on-call) carrying per-tier pending counts and elapsed-collection-lag; credential_roster publishes operator-pool throughput as a separate signal on control_lane so the validator can attribute saturation cause.

broadcast_pipeline's compromise-revocation handler MUST iterate deferred PHASE A entries (queryable via deferral records on control_lane) and rebind each deferred entry's signing-version-at-defer field to current roster_version at re-emission; deferred entries that have never been emitted simply bind to current signing roster_version (no envelope re-transmit). broadcast_pipeline emits a typed deferred-entries-rebound-to-version-V audit entry per cohort via compliance_audit_owner.

Each deferral record on control_lane is itself a signed artifact carrying its current signing-version-at-defer field; deferral records inherit the per-tenant signature-only-update rules so their lifecycle audit trail is coherent across rotation activations.

bulk_admitter emits two distinct end markers: bulk-wave-emit-end (broadcast_pipeline finished emitting the wave's drain-fence broadcasts) and bulk-wave-finalized (audit_destruct_sequencer signals every tenant in the wave has reached PHASE B DESTROYED or resolved-with-loss-attestation, OR the wave's finalization deadline has elapsed). wave_id correlation key references marker class; degradation-envelope expectation carries the marker-class tag so health_lane classifiers compare against the right window.

If a wave's documented finalization deadline elapses with tenants still un-DESTROYED and un-loss-attested, bulk_admitter (informed by audit_destruct_sequencer signal) emits a wave-finalization-overflow event onto control_lane + paged on-call carrying wave_id, unfinalized-tenant-count, and per-tenant blocking-cause categorization.

teardown_interlock's node-decommission admission CAS proposal precondition includes an in-flight-residency-2PC-PREPARE-set on this node read from residency_lock state in control_lane; decommission is rejected with reason 'residency-2pc-in-flight-on-node' if any PREPARE is still active. residency_lock publishes a per-region in-flight-PREPARE-set onto control_lane.

If node-decommission must proceed despite in-flight residency-2PC PREPAREs (operator-elevated through credential_validator), the admission carries an abort-and-handoff directive that atomically aborts all in-flight PREPAREs on the decommissioning region — transitioning each to PREPARED-ORPHAN with full audit attribution — AND signals credential_validator to admit any pending (tenant_key, V+next) recovery PREPAREs on a successor region under elevated M-of-N.

Lifecycle_gate subsystems classify audit emissions into two modes: (a) inline-audit — high-integrity / Tier-A entries (override admissions, decommission-handoff-loss attestations, PHASE B DESTROYED, residency-2PC abort directives) co-commit with the operational CAS proposal as a single atomic ext_compliance_audit_owner write; rejection on audit failure rolls back the operational decision. (b) deferred-audit — high-volume entries (drain-fence broadcasts, deferral records, wave markers, back-pressure signals) operationally commit independently; an audit-pending durable record is written to control_lane referencing the operational entry; a background flush pumps these into compliance_audit_owner. The per-audit-entry-type classification is documented and audited.

Subsystems publish their audit-pending durable record count onto control_lane; on compliance_audit_owner saturation, the audit-pending records are retained durably (no silent loss) and an audit-back-pressure event is paged on-call. compliance_audit_owner prioritizes drain by per-subsystem published audit-pending counts; lifecycle_gate refuses new bulk-wave admissions when audit-pending exceeds a configured horizon.

credential_validator persists every partial M-of-N collection as durable collection-checkpoint records on control_lane (signed by the replica, with collection_id + per-signer signature + collection_HLC + override-class); on re-entry, the recovering replica re-reads collection-checkpoints and resumes from the last checkpoint. Partial collections older than a configurable grace window without progress are typed-audited as 'collection-abandoned-on-recovery' and operator is paged.

satisfactions.explanation: residency_lock node maintains the per-tenant lock in lane_control via quorum_core CAS (PREPARE acquires, terminal releases); competing PREPARE rejected with 'residency-2PC-already-in-flight'; PREPARED-ORPHAN terminal-per-(tenant_key, V+1); recovery requires credential_validator-validated operator M-of-N elevated AND tenant_store clean-rollback-complete signal.

bulk_admitter's wave-admission CAS proposal precondition payload includes ext_lease_issuer's published CAS budget headroom AND every named-writer's bounded queue depth AND the residency_lock-published in-flight lock set; rejection reasons are typed; backs off with exponential-with-jitter.

teardown_interlock admits decommission only when every pending-flush handoff record owned by the buffer is resolved or transferred to a successor; transfer recursively re-applies the SLA contract; otherwise rejects.

audit_destruct_sequencer's PHASE B uses observed_ack_hlc only when every contributing drain-ack carried hlc_service-status=healthy; otherwise t_destroy is computed from worst-case drain-ack-pause-deferred completion HLC + skew_bound + write-delivery-grace and PHASE B does not commit until any pause-window ended and a healthy-mode drain-ack landed.

broadcast_pipeline re-emission stream emits per-tenant signature-only-update annotations for tenants whose offboarding_orchestrator phase markers had reached an ack-completed phase; updates the signing roster_version field without resetting the per-tenant ack window; only not-yet-ack-completed tenants get a fresh window.

broadcast_pipeline definition codifies a dedicated re-emission sub-stream sized as a fraction of total broadcast pipeline capacity, separate from new-wave admission, bounding impact on new-wave throughput.

credential_validator validates M-of-N signatures against ext_credential_roster's published roster, persists signing identities, and writes the override classification entry to lane_health with operator attribution; audited via ext_compliance_audit_owner.

bulk_admitter admits waves with documented max-tenants-per-wave and inter-wave spacing; per-writer bounded ack queue depth precondition stalls further wave admission rather than dropping broadcasts; per-tenant ack windows start from per-tenant ack-broadcast-emit-HLC sourced from ext_hlc_service.
